manifest.name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
manifest.description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat — Scene and Web in real time through the bundled WebWallGL engine, Video played directly — with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable blur/scrim/border/opacity, custom typography and caret, and a liquid-glass makeover of the whole settings window. Prerequisite: DeepSeek Harness 0.2 kernel (including 0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2) and Node.js >=22.12.0. No version restriction on dsh-better-sidebar.

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine bundle patch.
#
# Applied over the dsh-web-app layer. This bundle contributes NINE host rows:
#   - four owned by the main package: the plugin that scans Wallpaper Engine and
#     serves its media, the `about-notice` component row that owns the About tab's
#     two routes, the `mascot-avatar` component row that owns the mascot image +
#     the two session avatars, and the `media-bridge` component row that owns the
#     system media integration;
#   - five owned by `packages/{fx,parallax,fonts,glass,pet-link}`: the subpackages
#     this main package depends on (BUNDLE-SPLIT §7.1). Semantics A (§2.3) — the
#     main package owns these rows, each `name` is the subpackage's REAL package
#     name, and this patch is the single source of truth for the row set; a
#     subpackage's own cordis.patch.yml only takes effect when that subpackage is
#     installed as a standalone bundle (not the shape used here).
# The main package relies on its `dsh.client` manifest (in package.json) to load the
# browser half that draws the wallpaper behind the DSH GUI and adds the settings UI.
#
# A patch replaces the targeted row's whole `config`, so only additive
# `insert` rows appear here (we never override an existing shipped row).

- insert:
    # Host half: discovers the local Wallpaper Engine install (Steam app 431960),
    # enumerates Scene/Video/Web wallpapers from the Workshop + default projects
    # (Application wallpapers are listed but never rendered),
    # and serves their media + a JSON inventory over same-origin HTTP routes
    # the browser half fetches directly (GET /wallpaper-engine/inventory, /media,
    # /preview, …; docs/ROUTE-INDEX.md is the authoritative table — it is generated
    # and machine-checked, so the route count is deliberately not repeated here).
    - id: wallpaper-engine
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine'
    # Second row: the `about-notice` component's host half (C8′, P2-1). The host
    # loads it as its own plugin — its entry re-enters this bundle's
    # `applyComponent` — so disabling just this row removes the About tab's
    # /star-count + /about-qr routes and leaves the other 40 untouched.
    # P-F (2026-10-16): this component moved out to `packages/about-notice/`, so the
    # row `name` is now the real package name (resolved through <profile>/node_modules,
    # same as the fx / parallax / fonts rows below). The `id` is frozen.
    - id: wallpaper-engine-about-notice
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-about-notice'
    # Third row: the `mascot-avatar` component's host half (C6, P2-2) — the custom
    # mascot image (/mascot) and the two session avatars (/avatar/<side>). Same
    # shape as the row above (independent plugin, re-enters `applyComponent`);
    # disabling it removes just those two routes.
    # P-F (2026-10-16): this component moved out to `packages/mascot-avatar/`, so the
    # row `name` is now the real package name (resolved through <profile>/node_modules,
    # same as the fx / parallax / fonts rows below). The `id` is frozen.
    - id: wallpaper-engine-mascot-avatar
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-mascot-avatar'
    # Fourth row: the `media-bridge` component's host half (third component) — the
    # system media integration (now playing / spectrum / artwork / reverse control)
    # and its backend (the media-bridge child process with the built-in fallback).
    # Same shape as the rows above (independent plugin, re-enters `applyComponent`);
    # disabling it removes just those five routes. Default ON: turning it off loses
    # the media integration (user-visible), so the row ships enabled and the user
    # turns it off per-row if they do not want it.
    # P-F (2026-10-16): this component moved out to `packages/media-bridge/`, so the
    # row `name` is now the real package name (resolved through <profile>/node_modules,
    # same as the fx / parallax / fonts rows below). The `id` is frozen.
    - id: wallpaper-engine-media-bridge
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-media-bridge'
      # webServer is a hard dependency (`inject = ['webServer']` in lib/index.js):
      # the Loader waits for the HTTP server to mount, so a headless/TUI profile
      # without one does not load this bundle at all.
    # ── P-A 子包行（BUNDLE-SPLIT §7.1）────────────────────────────────────────────
    # 行的 name 是**子包的真名**（不是主包的子路径）：开发期解析靠
    # `scripts/dev-link-subpackages.mjs` 在 <profile>/node_modules 下建的目录 junction，
    # 与发布期 pnpm hoist 布局同形（§8.1 spike 结论）。主包 apply 会先 resolve 这三行，
    # 解析不到就**大声抛错**（宿主对行级失败是静默的 —— §4.1 I5）。
    # 可选桌宠联动；没有 dsh-pet 或首次准备未完成时保留吉祥物原生行为。
    - id: wallpaper-engine-pet-link
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-pet-link'
    # fx：点击拖尾 + 特效扩展（src/fx-layer.js、src/ext-fx.js），浏览器半边在本包自己的产物里。
    - id: wallpaper-engine-fx
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-fx'
    # parallax：3D 视差层（src/parallax-layer.js、src/ext-parallax.js），同上。
    - id: wallpaper-engine-parallax
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-parallax'
    # fonts：整个字体系统（P-C 之后宿主半边 + 浏览器半边都在本包）
    #   · 宿主半边：lib/routes/fontsets.js、lib/routes/system-fonts.js 两条路由族；
    #   · 浏览器半边：外观页签第六节「全局字体」+ 字体集编辑器 ⇒ 产物 lib/client.fonts.js。
    # 注意（§6.1 = A / ADR-0013 D20）：随包走的只是**渲染器与描述符**；字体的键、默认值、
    # 消毒与持久化仍在主包 lib/settings-schema.js（FONTSET_KEYS）与 fontsets/<id>.json。
    - id: wallpaper-engine-fonts
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-fonts'
    # glass：液态玻璃（ADR-0016 三刀出户）。
    #   · 第一刀（2026-10-27）：只登记行 + 键表 + 宿主自检可解析（host-only 空壳）；
    #   · 第二刀（2026-10-28）：外观页签「主题预设」+「玻璃 UI」设置节随包走（lib/client.glass.js；
    #     主包 panel-tabs 留按 id 取渲染器的注册表占位桩，屏上位置不变）；
    #   · 第三刀（2026-10-28）：玻璃运行时随包走（registerLayerHooks('glass') 行为层；weClampSurfaceColor /
    #     glassColorOf 家留主包 effects.js 经桥接取同一份；weGlassSurfaceStatus 经 registerGlassStatus 回传）；
    #   · 第四刀（2026-10-28 已落地）：玻璃 CSS 随包走（glass-css.js 自有 <style> 通道）⇒
    #     停用本行 = 玻璃样式表与行为层整体退场，宿主回到原生外观（wallpaper-only 态闭环）；
    #     侧栏/壳层的让位规则已改挂 data-we-glass-page（停玻璃行时回原生实色，不再全透明）。
    # 注意（§6.1 = A / ADR-0013 D20）：随包走的只是**渲染器**；玻璃的设置键、默认值、
    # 消毒与持久化仍在主包 lib/settings-schema.js（预设全档案快照也依赖单一 schema）。
    - id: wallpaper-engine-glass
      name: 'dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-glass'
    # ── 内置桌宠本体：已解耦（2026-10-20）────────────────────────────────────────
    # `packages/pet`（`dsh-we-pet-builtin`）与它的 `wallpaper-engine-pet` 行**已从本包移除**：
    # 它把 `electron`（optional）带进安装树，而 electron 42+ 在缺少 `dist/` 时会在
    # `require('electron')` 里**同步**下载约 140MB 二进制 ⇒ 宿主启动被堵到 60 秒超时，
    # 整个 profile 起不来。桌宠本体的正式接入等上游 dsh-pet 提供联动接口后，由 pet-link 对接
    # **外部** provider；在那之前 pet-link 的就绪面如实返回 unavailable（不静默假装可用）。

readme.text: [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine) [](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine/stargazers)[](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine/releases) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine)
把本机 **Wallpaper Engine** 的 Scene、Web 与视频壁纸带进 DSH 对话界面，再配上液态玻璃、字体、吉祥物与可分享的外观预设。插件不向 agent 注册工具、不注入提示文本，**不增加模型 token 开销**。
真实界面演示；历史素材与当前安装版本可能略有不同。

• 界面预览 · 主要能力 · 支持哪些壁纸
  • 快速开始 · 使用 · 兼容与限制
  • 开发与贡献 · 致谢
  • 赞赏 · 联系方式
生鱼的赞赏码
项目保持开源，赞赏完全自愿，不影响安装、使用或问题反馈。

- **壁纸**：Scene / Web 实时渲染，Video 直接播放；支持自定义图片 / 视频上传与 WE 项目目录。
- **外观**：设置窗、对话区与侧栏液态玻璃；配色、透明度、模糊、边框与字体可调。
- **玻璃子包**：液态玻璃是独立子包行 `wallpaper-engine-glass`，可在插件管理器单独停用；停用后，除内容区壁纸外界面回到宿中原生外观，壁纸、字体与吉祥物等功能不受影响。
- **扩展**：吉祥物、会话头像、点击 / 拖尾特效、3D 视差；可选桌宠联动 [dsh-pet-dshwe](https://github.com/Fish-under-sea/dsh-pet-dshwe)（dsh-pet 全量 fork），设置页卡片可一键安装，未装 / 关闭 / 版本过旧时回落原生吉祥物。
- **壁纸库**：筛选、隐藏 / 恢复、自动轮播；外观预设整套导入导出。

| 类型 | 在 DSH 中的路径 | 支持情况 |
|---|---|---|
| **Scene（场景）** | 内置 WebWallGL 实时渲染，失败时按降级链回退 | 支持，不需要 WE 在后台运行 |
| **Web（网页）** | 网页挂载、WE API 注入与沙箱隔离 | 支持；效果取决于网页与浏览器能力 |
| **Video（视频）** | 浏览器播放，配合转码、帧率上限与暂停控制 | 支持 |
| **Picture（图片 / 幻灯片项目）** | 读取 WE `preset` 项目的图片目录，按 WE 里设的周期在本机交叉淡化轮播 | 支持；图片不上传、留在本机 |
| **自定义图片 / 视频** | 上传本地 JPG / PNG / MP4 | 支持，文件保存在本机 |

Application（应用）类壁纸需要启动第三方程序，**不支持**，也不会进入壁纸库或轮播候选。
前置：**Node.js >= 22.12.0**、**DSH 0.2 内核**（含 `0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2`）与 **pnpm**。安装前完全退出 DSH。 **npm（推荐）** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine ``` 桌面端把 `web` 改为 `desktop`。

本仓按**多包发布集**发布：主包与同版本子包一起解析（具体包数、tarball 数与 `publishOrder` 见[发布说明](docs/RELEASING.md)，各版本变化见[变更记录](docs/CHANGELOG.md)）。

**源码**

```sh
node scripts/install-source.mjs --profile desktop --dsh-home "<DSH 数据目录>" --app-closed
```

源码安装会构建客户端并注册主包与子包；安装后不要移动或删除源码目录。完整说明见 [安装与升级](docs/UPGRADING.md) 与 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)；没有命令行经验请先看 [入门指南](README.beginner.md)。
1. 打开 **设置 → Wallpaper Engine → 壁纸库**，或在聊天顶部从吉祥物拉绳进入壁纸仓库。 2. 在页内壁纸库选择缩略图，按需调整播放与外观；修改即时生效并保存到宿主端。 3. 暂停 / 播放只控制当前播放；清除当前壁纸不会删除原文件。

- Windows / macOS / Linux 使用同一份源码；macOS 没有 WE 客户端，可上传图片 / 视频或指向 WE 项目目录。 - Scene 渲染依赖浏览器 WebGL 与显卡驱动，复杂工坊项目可能存在兼容差异；失败会逐级降级。 - 遮挡暂停、窗口失焦暂停与音频回环采集按平台适配；在线歌词默认关闭。 - 与其他皮肤 / 插件同时启用时，先看 [共存说明](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md#共存玻璃表面与其他-ui-插件)。

欢迎提交 Bug 复现、平台兼容反馈、文档修正和功能 PR。反馈时请附宿主 / 插件版本、操作系统、壁纸类型、复现步骤与脱敏日志。

Intro

Bring local **Wallpaper Engine** Scene, Web and Video wallpapers into DSH, with liquid glass, typography, mascots and shareable appearance presets. The plugin registers no agent tools or prompt text, so it adds no model token overhead.

Real interface demo; historical captures may differ slightly from the installed build.

• Preview · Features · Supported wallpapers
  • Quick start · Usage · Compatibility
  • Development · Special Thanks

Sponsor QR code
The project is open source; donations are entirely optional and never affect installation, usage or issue support.

- **Wallpapers**: live Scene / Web rendering, video playback, local image / video uploads and WE project directories.
- **Appearance**: liquid glass for settings, conversation and sidebar; colors, transparency, blur, borders and fonts.
- **Glass subpackage**: liquid glass is a standalone subpackage row, `wallpaper-engine-glass`, which can be disabled on its own in the plugin manager; with it disabled the host — except for the wallpaper shown in the content area — returns to its native look, while wallpapers, fonts and mascots keep working.
- **Extensions**: mascots, conversation avatars, click / pointer-trail effects, 3D parallax and optional desktop-pet integration with [dsh-pet-dshwe](https://github.com/Fish-under-sea/dsh-pet-dshwe) (a full fork of dsh-pet), installable in one click from the settings card and falling back to the native mascot when it is missing, disabled or too old.
- **Library**: filters, hide / restore, rotation lists and whole-configuration preset import / export.

| Type | How it works in DSH | Support |
|---|---|---|
| **Scene** | Built-in WebWallGL live rendering, with fallback chain | Supported; no WE process required |
| **Web** | Web page mounting, WE API shim and sandboxing | Supported; depends on the page and browser |
| **Video** | Browser playback with transcoding, fps cap and pause control | Supported |
| **Picture** | Reads the image folder of a WE `preset` project and crossfades locally at the interval set in WE | Supported; images are never uploaded |
| **Custom image / video** | Upload local JPG / PNG / MP4 | Supported; files stay local |

Application wallpapers require launching third-party executables and are **not supported**; they never enter the library or rotation candidates.

Quick start

Requires **Node.js >= 22.12.0**, a **DSH 0.2 kernel** (including `0.2.0-rc.1/rc.2`) and **pnpm**. Close DSH completely before installing. **npm (recommended)** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine ``` Use `desktop` instead of `web` for the desktop host.

The repository ships a **multi-package release set**: installing the main package resolves the same-version subpackages (current package/tarball counts and `publishOrder` live in [RELEASING](docs/RELEASING.md); per-version changes in [CHANGELOG](docs/CHANGELOG.md)).

**From source**

```sh
node scripts/install-source.mjs --profile desktop --dsh-home "<DSH data directory>" --app-closed
```

Keep the source directory in place after installation. See [upgrading](docs/UPGRADING.md) and [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md); see the [beginner guide](README.beginner.md#english) if you are new to the command line.

Usage

1. Open **Settings → Wallpaper Engine → Library**, or pull the mascot cord above the chat.
2. Pick a thumbnail in the in-panel library and adjust playback / appearance; changes apply immediately and persist on the host.
3. Pause / play controls only the current playback; clearing the current wallpaper never deletes the source file.

- Windows, macOS and Linux share the same source. macOS has no Wallpaper Engine client: upload images / videos or point custom-wallpaper storage at WE project directories.
- Scene rendering depends on browser WebGL and drivers; complex workshop projects may differ. Failures degrade gracefully.
- Occlusion pause, focus-loss pause and audio loopback are platform-adapted; online lyrics are off by default.
- When running with other skins / plugins, read [Coexistence](docs/en/HOW-IT-WORKS.md#coexistence-glass-surfaces-vs-other-ui-plugins) first.

Development

Bug reports, platform feedback, documentation fixes and feature PRs are welcome. Include host / plugin versions, OS, wallpaper type, reproduction steps and sanitized logs.
